import subprocess
import sys

BASE = {
    "version": 1, "ixps": [], "rib": [], "priors": [],
    "declared": [], "order": [], "queries": [],
}

def doc(**over):

def rib1():

cases = []

add('empty', b'')
add('top-list', [])
add('top-num', 5)
